news_cards.title: Bihar Sarkar Ki 100 Din Puri: Vikas Yojanaon Par Hui Charcha
bullets: Bihar sarkar ke 100 din poore hone par vikas yojanaon par charcha hui, jismein kai naye yojanaon ka elan kiya gaya.
Is yojana ke tahat 1307 karod rupye ka nivesh kiya jayega, jisse gaon ke vikas mein madad milegi.
Yeh yojana Bihar ke vikas mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayegi, jisse rajya ki arthvyavastha ko bhi badhava milega.

news_cards.title: Machhli Palan Par 60% Subsidy
bullets: Bihar sarkar dwara machhli palan par 60% subsidy di ja rahi hai, jisse kisanon ko labh hoga.
Is yojana ke tahat 31 August tak aweden karne ke liye mauka hai, jisse kisan apne machhli palan ka vystar kar sakenge.
Yeh yojana Bihar ke kisanon ke liye bahut faydemand hogi, jisse unki aay mein vriddhi hogi.

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Naye Rail Line Ka Nirmaan
bullets: Bihar mein naye rail line ka nirmaan kiya ja raha hai, jisse rajya ke vikas mein madad milegi.
Is rail line ke tahat 65 kilometer ganga channel ka vikas kiya jayega, jisse jal parivahan ko badhava milega.
Yeh rail line Bihar ke vikas mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayegi, jisse rajya ki arthvyavastha ko bhi badhava milega.
